name: Icon
description: SVG icon component. All icons are 24x24 viewBox, stroke-based, and use currentColor — they automatically inherit the text color of their parent (e.g. a Button variant), so any icon works in any context without color props.

name.description: Which icon to render. See vocabulary below for meaning and placement.

size.description: Pixel size. OMIT inside Button — Button.css sizes icons itself (24px LG / 16px SM).

extending: Add new icons in Icon.tsx: 24x24 viewBox, fill=none, stroke=currentColor, strokeWidth=2, round caps/joins. Then register the name in IconProps and add a vocabulary entry here.
a11y: Icon renders aria-hidden — it is always decorative. Meaning must come from the button label or aria-label.
